agents.description: Recommends controlled vocabularies, ontologies and data formats from FAIRsharing for a dataset profile, grounded on the registry records it retrieved.

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

TableField.description: One field of a tabular resource, mirroring a Frictionless Table Schema field descriptor. Frictionless publishes no RDF namespace, so these slots carry see_also rather than a slot_uri (TODO(#20): revisit if Frictionless publishes term IRIs).

field_type.description: Frictionless field type (string, number, integer, boolean, date, datetime, time, duration, geopoint, ...).

TableField.title: TableField

json_schema.description: A minimal description of a dataset being planned or prepared: what it is about and how it is shaped. Every slot maps onto an external vocabulary rather than a Data Director namespace.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

themes.description: Discipline or subject, as free text or an IRI.

json_schema.title: DatasetProfile

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

Recommendation.description: One recommended resource for one target. The resource is named only in grounded_on; its name, status and DOI are in the cited evidence item's content (docs/specs/grounding.md).

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

target.description: dataset, or field:<name> for a field-level recommendation.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a recommendation.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. snapshot:2026-09-04 or live.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary
